stem_book: Three identical spherical balls A, B and C are placed on a table as shown in the figure along a straight line. B and C are at rest initially. The ball A hits B head on with a speed of 10 m s⁻¹. Then after all collisions (assumed to be elastic) A and B are brought to rest and C takes off with a velocity of : (a) 5 m s⁻¹ (b) 10 m s⁻¹ (c) 2.5 m s⁻¹ (d) 7.5 m s⁻¹
key: B 10 m s −1 You marked: D
work: equal masses, elastic head-on: velocities exchange A→B→C, so v_C = 10 m/s
